_comment: Shared static walking-path data for Intramuros, loaded identically by the Flutter app (lib/screens/navigation_screen.dart) and the HTML/JS dashboard (assets/intravel/index.html). Straight-line segments between named nodes (gates + major landmarks with verified coordinates), not a live-routed path. This is a reasonable approximation for a small, fixed walking area, matching the same standard already accepted for nearest-neighbor itinerary sequencing (Section 3.4). Coordinates for gates come from lib/services/gate_service.dart; coordinates for landmarks come from lib/services/location_service.dart (both already verified/established elsewhere in the project, not invented here). Distances are used for straight-line fallback segments when a specific stop-to-stop pair has no explicit path segment defined.
